q: How does a Pali dyeing and printing unit count CO2 from its boiler?
title: Pali dyeing unit boiler CO2
short: Multiply the coal, lignite or wood used each month by its emission factor: coal and lignite in full in Scope 1, wood with its CO2 reported as biogenic. Add electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Divide by metres or kilograms processed.
audience: Textile dyeing and printing units in Pali and Balotra, Rajasthan

ul: Coal or lignite: weigh at receipt and note GCV from the supplier.
Wood or agro waste: CO2 biogenic, methane and N2O in Scope 1.
Thermic fluid heaters count the same way.

p: Units from bills at the CEA factor; the shared effluent plant's power is usually billed separately.
Divide by fabric processed, keeping dyeing and printing apart if heat use differs.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a figure can be traced to its source.
